Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.

On March 3, 2025, Example Corp entered into an agreement under which the Chip Vendor agreed to purchase residual unsold capacity through April 13, 2032, with an initial order value of $6.3 billion.

The Chip Vendor also purchased shares of Class A common stock for an aggregate purchase price of $250 million.

The term runs from 2025–2032 under the master agreement and related order forms.
